description: Department of Transport and Main Roads On Time Payments is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Department of Transport and Main Roads performance reporting on the Queensland Government On-time Payment policy which was implemented on 1 July 2020. This policy replaces the Late Payments dataset which ended on 30th June 2020. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are DTMR, TMR, late payments, on-time payments, reporting. It offers 6 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
